Delete resources by type and name.

Every name is resolved before anything is deleted, so a name that does not exist leaves the others
untouched unless --ignore-not-found is set. Deleting a group also deletes the registrations of its
projects; the default group cannot be deleted.

Deleting a project removes its registration only. The repository on disk is not touched.

Resource types: projects (project, proj) and groups (group). Type words are case-insensitive.

Usage: slipway delete [OPTIONS] (<TYPE> <NAME>... | <TYPE/NAME>...)

Arguments:
  <TYPE>
          The resource type, by its plural, singular or short name (see api-resources).

  [NAME]...
          The name of a resource of that type.

Options:
      --dry-run
          Print what would change and write nothing.

      --ignore-not-found
          Treat "resource not found" as a successful delete.

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h').

Examples:
  # Delete a project from the current group
  slipway delete project hldr

  # Delete two projects from the work group
  slipway delete projects api web -n work

  # Delete a group and the registrations of its projects
  slipway delete group work

  # Delete a project if it exists, quietly otherwise
  slipway delete project hldr --ignore-not-found

Use "slipway --help" for a list of global options (applies to all commands).
